release_notes.headline_internal: Repair three compensating anti-patterns at their owning mechanism; classify and retain four legitimate defenses
release_notes.headline_external: Internal reliability hardening in configuration loading and release automation
highlights: Project-config loading now has a single access/read/parse/validate boundary; both public entry points derive from one classifier instead of disagreeing about corrupt input

Release automation distinguishes malformed GitHub CLI output from empty output across six call sites via a typed empty|ok|malformed union with exhaustive switches, giving PR_STATE_UNPARSEABLE its first test coverage
Removed a dead guard wrapping existsSync, which cannot throw for string arguments
Recorded durable evidence-backed classifications for all seven candidates examined, including the four retained as legitimate defense and one that proved not to be a defect
